{{Short description|Study of human characteristics in the states of Alderney}}

[[File:Guernsey-Alderney.png|thumb|Island of Alderney]]
The '''demography of Alderney''' is analysed by the [[States of Alderney]] and produced in Census reports. A Census was lasted held in 2013 however more recently {{Proper name|eCensus}} demographics are compiled annually using various [[Bailiwick of Guernsey]] databases.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.alderney.gov.gg/article/117359/Population|title=Population|last=|first=|date=|website=[[States of Alderney]]|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160321064827/http://www.alderney.gov.gg/article/117359/Population |archive-date=2016-03-21 |access-date=12 September 2019}}</ref>

== Population ==
As of 2017 the population of the island was estimated via the {{Proper name|eCensus}} to be 1,985 with a seasonal population of over 3,000 during the summer because of tourism.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.acre.gov.gg/about-alderney|title=About Alderney|last=|first=|date=|website=Alderney Commission for Renewable Energy|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160801002348/http://www.acre.gov.gg/about-alderney |archive-date=2016-08-01 |access-date=12 September 2019}}</ref>

== Gender ==
Gender disparity on the island is calculated by the Social Security Department and published in the annual {{Proper name|eCensus}} report. Since 2008 Alderney has had a majority female population which has fluctuated between  50.5% and 51.4%.<ref name=":0" />
